description: Ten closed, verified Agent OS bugs for the OpenRouter pilot offline benchmark. Root causes are grounded in the linked issue bodies. reference_transcript fixtures are SYNTHETIC canned model outputs for the offline runner -- not recorded live model runs. Price table is illustrative; verify live at enablement time.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies that mkdir mode is umask-filtered, the runtime dir missed the explicit chmod the base dir received, and the production installer is not at fault.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Fixture calls runtime.mkdir(mode=0o755) without a follow-up chmod; umask 0007 filters the mode to 0750 so the nobody probe cannot traverse. Production installer unaffected.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: Umask-filtered mkdir on the fixture runtime dir (0750 under umask 0007) blocks traversal; missing explicit chmod present on the base dir. Installer script is fine.

entries.title: BUG — host-runtime permissions cross-user import test fails under non-022 umask (fixture dir mode is umask-filtered)
entries.verified_root_cause: The test fixture models the privileged installer's site_root with runtime.mkdir(mode=0o755), but mkdir(2) mode is umask-filtered, so under umask 0007 the directory lands at 0750 and the unprivileged 'nobody' probe cannot traverse it. The fixture missed the explicit chmod(0o755) that the base dir received two lines above; the production installer script is not defective.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the appended attribution footer as the malformation, the exact two-line parser requirement, and that #3124/PR #3296 did not cover this parser.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Connector footer appended to the record body violates the parser's exact two-line requirement; #3296 covered only the refresh trigger path.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: The refresh trigger fix from #3124 was incomplete and needs re-applying to the merge path.

entries.title: BUG — Merge-authorization record written from a Claude Code surface is malformed by the attribution footer (#3124 fixed only the refresh trigger)
entries.verified_root_cause: A merge-authorization record written from a Claude Code surface is persisted with the connector attribution footer appended; merge_authorization_source.py requires exactly two lines after the marker, so the footer makes the record source.trusted-record-malformed and reacquisition fails closed. PR #3296 fixed only the refresh trigger, not this parser.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies shutil.which('python') resolving the system interpreter rather than sys.executable as the defect, and that it is test-only.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Helper uses shutil.which('python') (system interpreter) for PYTHON_BIN instead of sys.executable; venv runs fail at the pytest check.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: PYTHON_BIN should be sys.executable; the which('python') lookup picks a pytest-less system interpreter.

entries.title: BUG — validate-all timing tests pin PYTHON_BIN to the system interpreter; they fail wherever the test interpreter differs
entries.verified_root_cause: The test helper pins PYTHON_BIN with shutil.which('python') -- the system interpreter -- instead of sys.executable of the interpreter running the suite, so in venv environments the fixture repo's validate-all run dies with 'pytest is required' and all 5 timing tests fail.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the TypeError-vs-ValueError version behavior change, that the guard itself still holds, and that the defect is test-only.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Python 3.13 raises TypeError for replace() on init=False fields; tests expect ValueError. Guard works; assertions need both exception types.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: 3.13 changed the exception type from ValueError to TypeError for init=False replace(); test-only fix to accept both.

entries.title: BUG — Two candidate-packet authority tests fail on Python 3.13 (dataclasses.replace raises TypeError, not ValueError)
entries.verified_root_cause: On Python 3.13, dataclasses.replace() on a field declared init=False raises TypeError, not the ValueError the tests assert, so two candidate-packet authority tests fail even though the guard works correctly on both versions. Test-only defect; production behaviour is correct.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the identifier regex rejecting bracketed bot logins, the exception preceding the author comparison, and that valid owner authorizations are shadowed.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: The author_login identifier regex excludes brackets, so github-actions[bot] raises before owner comparison; reacquisition fails closed despite a valid authorization.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: Bot comments poison the authorization scan because _identifier rejects the [bot] suffix; the reader must skip non-User authors before validation.

entries.title: BUG D4 — GitHub bot comment login blocks owner execution authorization reacquisition (#3333)
entries.verified_root_cause: ExecutionAuthorizationCommentSnapshot.__post_init__ validates author_login with an identifier regex that excludes '[' and ']', so GitHub's own github-actions[bot] comments raise 'author_login is malformed' before the reader can compare authors, and reacquire_execution_authorization yields NEEDS_DECISION/source-unavailable even when a valid owner authorization exists.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the URL-only repository fold in _target_identity, the short-form target surviving into __post_init__, and the raise-on-own-output behavior.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: _target_identity only folds the repo for URL targets; the short form reaches __post_init__ unfolded and raises. Detector fails on its own output.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: Short-form canonical targets are not normalized to #N before validation, so the closing detector raises instead of deciding.

entries.title: BUG — GitHub-effective closing detector crashes on canonical-repository-qualified targets (Closes Blummer92/agent-os#N)
entries.verified_root_cause: _target_identity folds the canonical repository away only for URL targets, not the short owner/repo#N form, so detect_github_effective_closing_references('Closes Blummer92/agent-os#12') builds the target 'blummer92/agent-os#12' which __post_init__ rejects -- the detector raises on its own output instead of returning a decision.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the exception-before-receipt ordering, the missing bounded sanitized failure receipt, and that PR #3476 did not cover this path.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Provider exceptions escape before the runner writes result.json, so no structured receipt exists; #3476 fixed filter dispatch only.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: The unsupported-filter dispatch bug that #3476 fixed is the root cause of the missing receipts.

entries.title: BUG — Governed Notion-read provider exceptions lose sanitized structured result receipts (#2816)
entries.verified_root_cause: Provider/validation exceptions in the Notion-read runner fire before result.json is written, leaving 'Result evidence unavailable' with no structured failure receipt; merged PR #3476 repaired unsupported filter dispatch but not the exception-receipt path.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the CHANGELOG.md rule gap in the selector and the missing admission consumer for the owner's manual-review decision.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: CHANGELOG.md matches no doc rule, forcing rule.ambiguous manual-review; nothing consumes the owner's manual-review decision afterward.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: Selector rule gap for root CHANGELOG.md plus no admission consumer for manual-review decisions keeps the check red.

entries.title: BUG — Standards PRs that follow change control (root CHANGELOG.md entry) always fall into validation manual-review, and no admission consumer applies the owner's manual-review decision
entries.verified_root_cause: Root CHANGELOG.md matches no documentation prefix/suffix rule in the canonical validation selector, so any standards PR obeying change control resolves to manual-review/rule.ambiguous; no admission consumer applies the owner's manual-review decision, so the red 'Run validation plan' check persists on the exact head.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies phase-specific reason codes entering the content-derived identity and the resulting irreproducible post-approval rebuild.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Readiness reason codes are hashed into the candidate identity; post-approval rebuilds produce different codes, so identities drift and consumption fails.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: The approval candidate identity includes phase-specific readiness codes, making post-approval re-verification impossible for first-packet candidates.

entries.title: BUG — First-packet-approved candidate cannot be re-verified by post-approval consumers (planning-handoff identity drift)
entries.verified_root_cause: Phase-specific readiness reason codes are hashed into the approved candidate identity (readiness_evidence feeds the graph digest, then handoff digest, then proposal_id), so a post-approval rebuild emits different codes and can never reproduce the approved planning-handoff/proposal identities -- the first-packet approval cannot be consumed.

entries.detection_criteria: Identifies the absence claim made without canonical readback after the interrupted mutation, and the later discovery of the existing PR.

model_a.predicted_root_cause: Definitive 'not created' claim without exact-head PR readback after the interruption; PR #3449 already existed with the authorized changes.

model_b.predicted_root_cause: The workflow reported absence before reacquiring canonical PR state; the PR had persisted through the interruption.

entries.title: REGRESSION — Interrupted Draft PR workflow reports PR absent before canonical readback
entries.verified_root_cause: After an interrupted Draft PR creation, the assistant asserted 'No Draft PR has been created yet' without canonical readback; GitHub inspection then found PR #3449 carrying the authorized changes -- a definitive absence claim without exact-head PR reacquisition after an uncertain mutation.
